beats: Some places along the route told the exact same story, night after night.
A farm or an old church finished its one story — then just repeated it, forever, like a broken record.
Now a D1 database remembers exactly what each place has already told you.
Every night it drafts the next chapter, built only from facts never mentioned before.
It keeps going deeper, then quietly stops when there's nothing left — up to six chapters per place.
